name: jgents
description: JGENTS plugins: the pixel-art virtual office of your Claude Code sessions.

plugins.name: jgents
plugins.description: JGENTS mod: plan usage (5-hour and weekly) for the office, a notice under the prompt when another session needs you, and the /jgents command.

plugins.name: jgents-permissions
plugins.description: Approve or deny Claude Code's permission requests and answer the agent's questions from JGENTS (PermissionRequest hook).

plugins.name: jgents-messages
plugins.description: Send messages from JGENTS: what you type in the office goes into the session as if you had typed it in the terminal.
